artifacts.notes: Historical human English translation reprinted from the London Tablet, January 4, 1930; individual translator unnamed. Complete native printed pp. 41–58, address, title, all 42 source notes, blessing and dated closing inspected. This printing supplies no separate papal-name subscription. Artifact pages 8–9 repeat printed pp. 46–47 and are omitted as duplicate scans, while their first scans remain. The independent Retreat Congress article begins below the closing on p. 58. The exact XML WORD selection retains OCR errors, lost drop-cap Y, original hard-line hyphens and source punctuation. One explicitly audited node permutation restores the native p. 42 note order without changing word strings. This is extent/identity review, not a corrected transcription or Latin-versus-English accuracy certification.
